name: parsed_message
description: Schema for classifying development finance project records by local implementation and employment-related treatment relevance.

annotation_record_id.description: Stable identifier of the annotation input row. Must match the input annotation_record_id.

locally_implemented.description: Whether the project involves local implementation, delivery, physical works, services, equipment, training, or place-based activity.

macro_policy_only.description: Indicates whether the project is purely macro policy, budget support, regulation, national strategy, or central institutional reform with no described local implementation.

jobs_direct.description: Indicates whether the project explicitly mentions jobs, employment, workers, labor, skills training, livelihoods, income generation, cash-for-work, public works, SMEs, or enterprise support.

jobs_indirect.description: Indicates whether the project has a concrete local or productive channel that plausibly supports employment or productive activity even if jobs are not explicitly mentioned.

jobs_any.description: Overall jobs relevance. Should be Yes if jobs_direct is Yes or jobs_indirect is Yes. Use Unclear only when evidence is insufficient or conflicting.

non_jobs.description: Indicates whether the project should be treated as not jobs-related. Should usually be the inverse of jobs_any, except when evidence is unclear.

jobs_channel.description: Main mechanism linking the project to employment or productive activity. Use none when no jobs channel is present.

confidence.description: Confidence in the annotation based only on the provided project text.

needs_second_review.description: Whether the record should be reviewed by a human or second model pass because it is ambiguous, mixed, weak-text, borderline, or important for treatment definition.

evidence_summary.description: Brief summary of the textual evidence used for the annotation. Do not invent facts beyond the input text.

local_implementation_rationale.description: Brief explanation for the locally_implemented and macro_policy_only labels.

jobs_rationale.description: Brief explanation for the jobs_direct, jobs_indirect, jobs_any, non_jobs, and jobs_channel labels.

review_notes.description: Concise notes about ambiguity, missing information, or why second review is needed. Use an empty string if none.
